rows.Primary Job to Be Done: Turn wearable data into next actions.
rows.Primary Pain: Too many metrics, not enough meaning.
rows.Existing Belief: More data should make health easier.
rows.Desired Outcome: Know what sleep, stress and recovery patterns suggest.
rows.New Belief Required: Interpreted data beats more raw metrics.

rows.Primary Job to Be Done: Understand body composition without booking a clinic scan.
rows.Primary Pain: Weight alone does not answer whether hidden fat is changing.
rows.Existing Belief: If I look okay, I am probably okay.
rows.Proof Required: Segmental body-composition and app trend demo.
rows.Desired Outcome: Get a clearer body-composition signal at home.
rows.New Belief Required: Hidden composition signals matter more than weight alone.
rows.Persona / Situation Name: Man over 40 worried about hidden visceral fat

rows.Primary Pain: Plateau makes the whole plan feel pointless.
rows.Desired Outcome: Understand what changed when pounds did not.

rows.Primary Pain: Body changes feel confusing and unfair when weight stalls.
rows.Existing Belief: My body is broken if the scale will not move.
rows.Proof Required: Fat, muscle and hydration trend visuals.
rows.New Belief Required: Body recomposition and hydration shifts can hide progress.
rows.Persona / Situation Name: Menopausal woman frustrated weight is not changing

rows.Primary Job to Be Done: Stay consistent with minimal mental overhead.
rows.Primary Pain: Health routines break when feedback is vague.
rows.Existing Belief: I need willpower more than measurement.
rows.Desired Outcome: Weekly feedback that keeps habits visible.
rows.New Belief Required: Measurement can create accountability without obsession.

rows.Primary Pain: Scale does not reflect strength or muscle changes.
rows.Existing Belief: The scale proves whether workouts work.
rows.Desired Outcome: See whether training is changing muscle and fat.
rows.New Belief Required: Training success can show up in composition before weight.
rows.Persona / Situation Name: Gym user gaining strength but not losing weight

rows.Primary Pain: Does not trust another subscription-heavy tracker.
rows.Desired Outcome: Track recovery and stress trends with clearer value.
rows.New Belief Required: A wearable should explain patterns, not just collect data.

rows.Primary Job to Be Done: Monitor body-composition quality during weight loss.
rows.Primary Pain: Fast weight loss may include muscle loss.
rows.Desired Outcome: Track fat loss while preserving muscle trends.
rows.New Belief Required: Composition quality matters as much as weight loss.
rows.Persona / Situation Name: GLP-1 user worried about losing muscle
